OUR STORY

Born in the mud.
Built for the trails.

SB Racing — Soggy Bottom Racing — started in 2026 when a crew of shift workers from CF Industries in Medicine Hat needed dirt after long days at the plant. After-work laps in the coulees turned into a club: group rides, trail maps, merch, and a place to show up even when the forecast is ugly.

We ride the badlands and prairie around Medicine Hat, Redcliff, Elkwater, and Cypress Hills. Technical coulee singletrack, high-speed flow, and poker-run checkpoints on the same map. Beginners and regulars are both welcome — no ego, just good people on bikes.

The website and the official iOS app are the same club toolkit: RSVP to rides, record GPS with trail splits and live stats, chase a rider score on the leaderboard, scan poker-run QRs, and keep up on Soggy Bottom HQ.

WHAT WE ACTUALLY DO
  • Group rides, clinics, socials, and poker runs — RSVP in the app or on the site
  • Trail maps for Medicine Hat, Redcliff, Elkwater & Cypress Hills

  • Club leaderboard, personal stats, and badges
  • Soggy Bottom HQ: photos, clips, comments, and club updates
  • Open club — create an account and you are on the members list
OFFICIAL iOS APP

SB Racing on the App Store

The same club tools you use here — maps, live GPS, trail splits, stats, and poker-run checkpoints — on iPhone. Tap Start when you roll out. Recording keeps going with the screen locked.

  • Trail maps for Medicine Hat, Redcliff, Elkwater, and Fernie
  • GPS tracking: distance, moving time, elevation, avg and top speed
  • Auto trail splits and end-to-end times when you pass a start or finish
  • Rider score, personal bests, and club comparison graphs
  • Leaderboard by week, month, and year — volume points plus skill score
  • RSVP to group rides and see spots left
  • Scan poker-run QRs and follow event standings
